targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM alerts
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM alerts

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%H', ts) || '시' AS hour, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%H', ts) || '시' AS hour, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM alerts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT ts AS 시각, camera AS 카메라, track_id AS 사람번호, event AS 내용 FROM alerts ORDER BY ts DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts AS 시각, camera AS 카메라, track_id AS 사람번호, event AS 내용 FROM alerts ORDER BY ts DESC
